implementation: Extended membership rows with provider, shop and sports-venue primary keys while retaining owner, role, type, name, owner-wide membership semantics and the merchant_staff gate.
Forward-recreated list_my_business_memberships with explicit authenticated-only grants.
Added selected-owner shop history read guarded by exact owner identity or active _acts_for membership with merchant_staff enabled; actual owners remain able to read while merchant_staff is OFF.
Kept safe shop fields explicit, GSTIN owner-only, and category slugs empty when the existing products capability is OFF; no provider or payout fields are returned.
Kept get_my_business_shop() unchanged; getMyShop(ownerId) calls the new RPC only when ownerId is explicitly supplied.
testCoverageAuthored: ID-MEM-BUSINESS-PKS: actual provider, shop and venue PKs are returned; missing-user and merchant_staff-OFF denials plus authenticated-only RPC grants are asserted.
ID-MULTI-VENUE-SAME-NAME: two same-name venues remain distinct under one owner-wide membership.
ID-SHOP-SELECT-B: explicit owner B returns B, not the first eligible shop A, with only safe fields.
ID-SHOP-DENY: stranger, inactive member and delegated member with merchant_staff OFF are denied; owner remains authorized with owner-rank GSTIN.
ID-SHOP-FLAG-PARENTS: owner and authorized staff retain history when products are OFF, while save_product remains denied.
ID-LEGACY-SHOP-READ: legacy no-argument SQL and app RPC behavior remains available with capability flags OFF.
App API tests assert business_id preservation and providerId forwarding.

codespace.detail: The current-main helper's gh codespace list call returned HTTP 404 for https://api.github.com/repos/sushruth5454/quickserve/codespaces?per_page=30 and reported that the GitHub token needs the codespace scope. The helper then emitted InvalidOperation because no Codespace value was returned. No selector ran; no auth scope change was attempted.
